title: Improved stability estimates at elliptic equilibria of Hamiltonian systems
summary: This paper deals with an improvement of the "a-priori stability bounds" on the variation of the action variables and on the stability time obtained from a given Birkhoff normal form around the elliptic equilibrium point of an Hamiltonian system satisfying a non-resonance condition of finite order N.
